execution_time.analysis: Execution is fast due to deterministic local parsing. External subprocessing (ffprobe) is synchronous but acceptable for small scale.

api_call_count.analysis: 0 API calls are made for core generation, relying entirely on local Python logic.

resource_consumption.analysis: Reads files directly into memory which is fine for current scale.

output_completeness.analysis: Data bindings work well, but we must ensure that the final HTML exactly binds all contents by enforcing strict parsing regex for the Markdown tables to prevent lost data on malformed inputs.
solutions: Ensure strict parsing of Markdown rows and handle malformed rows so that all insights and transcript content bind exactly to the final HTML without omissions.

format_compliance.analysis: HTML conforms to Ant Design/Tailwind specification.

content_accuracy.analysis: 100% accurate since it deterministically copies exact markdown content into HTML without LLM hallucination.

human_approval_rate.analysis: Consistent UI generation should result in high approval.

skip_logic_compatibility.analysis: Output file acts as clear marker for idempotency/skip-logic.

idempotency.analysis: Generates identical HTML file on repeated runs.

error_rate.analysis: Parsing logic is stable, though highly dependent on upstream markdown formatting.

error_recoverability.analysis: Fails cleanly with stack trace if markdown is completely broken.

retry_success_rate.analysis: No transient network issues to retry.

scaling_behavior.analysis: Scales linearly with the number of rows.

unit_test_coverage.analysis: The existing test suite (test_visualize_html.py) still tests the old AI-based logic (mocking Agent) instead of the new deterministic functions (get_folder_stats, extract_summary_insights).
solutions: Update tests/test_visualize_html.py to remove deprecated AI tests and cover the new deterministic get_folder_stats and extract_summary_insights functions.
